notes.title: Update 0.03
notes.notes:
Hooray !!! - We have released the update. Our team apologizes for the delay.
We've been through some tough times but that's all behind us now and we're ready to go again. Here's a list of updates for Halloween day.

[list]
[*] New map (old ones are gone).
[*] Map updated for Halloween.
[*] New character.
[*] You can turn off the lights in almost every room.
[*] Added a switch that turns off lights throughout the house.
[*] Damage from player's flashlight increased.
[*] Normal lights in rooms no longer cause damage to players.
[*] New music.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.02
notes.notes:
[b]List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated player movement system.
[*] Updated the player's camera.
[*] Updated and reconfigured networking light functions.
[*] Fixed bugs in the stairs.
[*] Updated and re-configured door networking functions.
[*] Removed all physical objects (we'll bring them back in the future).
[*] Fixed bugs in teleport doors.
[*] Changed user interface (test, will change soon).
[*] Redesigned lobby system.
[*] Added a leaderboard (ranking for captured players).
[*] Now if a player is hiding, he earns points for the team (it is important not to move or sit down).
[*] Added team voice chat.
[*] Added simple bots.
[*] Now you can change the settings of the lobby (name, map, password, game mode, rounds, round time, bots).
[*] Removed the Diamond map, but updated the Underground map to be larger.
[/list]
We also fixed many minor bugs and optimized the gameplay.

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have a new artist in our team, in the future the game will be completely redrawn, but the atmosphere and meaning of the game will remain.
[*] We are planning to hold a tournament closer to winter.
[*] We have collected a certain budget in order to start an advertising campaign.
[*] Maps in alpha are being tested, after that, they will be redrawn.
[/list]

Thanks to all the players for writing to us about their wishes and errors found. We tried to update the game as soon as possible.
